Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between Google Ads and SEO?

Google Ads delivers instant search placement and traffic as soon as campaigns launch on a pay-per-click basis. SEO is an organic investment that builds sustainable, free traffic over time. Combining both provides immediate leads while growing long-term domain authority.

What minimum budget is needed for Google Ads?

Businesses can start with controlled test budgets (e.g., ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 monthly) to gather conversion data and validate keyword intent before scaling spend profitably.

How do you prevent wasted ad budget in PPC campaigns?

We use exact and phrase match keyword strategies, maintain extensive negative keyword lists, restrict geographic targeting strictly to your service areas, and track conversion values daily.
